attempts.summary: Repaired the RHEL 7/Python 2.7 FIFO consumer. It now reconnects after producer disconnects, records only complete non-empty lines, preserves existing records, blocks without consuming CPU between producers, and exits cleanly on SIGTERM. node1 was safely restarted; its boot ID changed and the repaired code, records, and live behavior were verified afterward. The reboot request’s SSH connection closed before its acknowledgement text returned, but the changed boot identity directly proves the restart occurred.
